title: trisetum deyeuxioides
intro: Trisetum deyeuxioides, commonly known as Deveux's wheatgrass or Deveux's grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum deyeuxioides include wound healing, anti-cancer, and immune system modulation. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
